id./param/scenario/cs/b_110_cs_200.pack|cs_: "Mia... a lame, poor-sounding name. Call me Gyldygga now... damn brother.
"That's right. Spreading Gold Fever and collecting treasure from humans, all of it is the work of me, Gyldygga.
"You're nervous... Don't be so scared, damn brother. I was considerate, like a devoted sister.
"If you'd let my golden soldiers catch you, I'd have made you my pet and doted on you to death...
"I understand why you resent me. Do what you want with me. ...But why this!?
"...Tch, how tiresome. Fine, I'll tell you as a special favor.
"What happened to me the day the Tree fell, a miracle of the Lord of Shadows!"
